description: Add structured aid stations, checkpoints, cutoffs, and canonical resources to a CRSProf artifact that lacks them. Before enriching, inspect whether the imported source already contains GPX/CRSProf waypoints; if it already contains GPX/CRSProf waypoints, avoid duplicate Start/Finish/aid stations and prefer merging/updating resources, cutoffs, notes, or links on existing waypoint metadata. Prefer waypoints.mode=structured; put non-canonical/free-text aid details in notes/source text because unsupported resource strings are ignored with warnings. Route-only plans should be labeled incomplete unless the CRSProf already includes official waypoints/resources/cutoffs or the user explicitly accepts missing aid/resource details.

crsprof_artifact_id.description: CRSProf artifact ID returned by import_course or get_artifact.

cutoff.description: Elapsed cutoff time HH:MM, if known.

name.description: Waypoint, aid station, checkpoint, start, or finish name.

resources.description: Canonical aid/resources available here. Unsupported/free-text strings are ignored with warnings; preserve non-canonical details in note/source text.

mode.description: Use structured for reliable AI workflows.

source_ref.description: Optional source reference for parsed waypoint rows.

start_time.description: Optional race start time used when parsing absolute cutoffs.

table_url.description: Public URL to an aid-station table for best-effort parsing; verify results. If official documents disagree or exact aid locations are not listed, ask the user to confirm rather than inventing missing aid stations.

text.description: Raw aid-station table text for best-effort table parsing.

name: enrich_course_waypoints

severity.description: Problem severity, usually warning or error.

job_id.description: CourseProfiler job ID to poll with get_job.

result_artifacts.description: Artifacts produced by the job, including role metadata.

download_url.description: Artifact download URLs are private and short-lived; share them only with the user, verbatim in a code block, not a clickable link. Ask the user to copy the entire URL into their browser address bar. Do not rewrite the URL or add tracking parameters such as utm_source: changes invalidate the signature. If expired, call get_artifact for a fresh URL. This applies only to artifact download_url values, not authorization or upload links.

type.description: Artifact type, e.g. crsprof, usrprof, pdf, json, or source_file.

status.description: Job status, e.g. queued, running, succeeded, or failed.
